system.description:
You shorten every temper in the room, kindling disagreements and brawls and, in suitably volatile Kindred, outright frenzy.

Spend a Willpower Trait to activate this power for the remainder of the scene. Everyone within 10 feet grows increasingly hostile toward those around them, and the irritation lingers (though no longer enhanced) even after they leave your presence. Enraged vampires may whip themselves into frenzy. Anyone affected may spend a Willpower Trait to calm down for one turn and refrain from frenzying; those with the Calm Hearted Merit may spend a Willpower Trait to resist the effect for a minute. The anger is best roleplayed rather than reduced to tests.
